sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Prior repair instructions remain valid. The stress-analysis alternative is still a presence-only approximation: approvedSpindleTorqueStressAnalysis must encode the required approved evidence/direct-determination relationship showing that the analysis directly determines maximumSpindleTorque, not merely require an approvalRecord-typed value. Preserve the ship-owned maximumSpindleTorque result and the formula branch with all operands and result checks using expected-result-scaled tolerance.
